title: What a stop loss actually saves you
note: Rewritten 2026-09-09 in the spoken register (CHARACTER_BIBLE 'How she talks') and re-cut character-led: 4 of 7 scenes are Lia. Education first -- the reel explains a concept and makes no claim about Lumin's results. The only product claim is the hard stop, which is the app's own onboarding line and is on screen as the `stop_on_every` proof.
voice: Okay — real talk. Most people learn what a stop loss is the hard way. So, short version: a stop loss is the price where your trade closes itself. And you pick that price before you're in — not while you're staring at a red number, trying to talk yourself into holding. In Lumin, every position opens with a stop already sitting there. You can't open one without it. So the loss is a number you chose, instead of a number you found out about. Every signal's free. It's on Google Play.
